paper.title_en: The decay $η_c\to p\bar pη$ with meson--baryon final-state interactions
paper.abstract_en: We study the decay \(η_c\to p\bar{p}η\) by combining the SU(3) flavor structure of the primary production with final-state interactions in the \(pη\) and \(\bar{p}η\) subsystems, using the chiral unitary approach. The low-energy \(S_{11}\) dynamics, including the dynamically generated \(N^*(1535)\), is incorporated into the complete coupled-channel amplitude, and a phenomenological \(N^*(1895)\) contribution is included coherently. The \(pη\) and \(\bar{p}η\) invariant-mass distributions are well described, and the \(p\bar{p}\) distribution is predicted as a kinematic reflection of the \(ηN\) dynamics. The results support the dynamical interpretation of the \(N^*(1535)\) and suggest possible additional \(S_{11}\) strength near \(1.9\)~GeV.
